problem.name: Pattern matching with mismatches
problem.statement_latex: Given $P\in\Sigma^m$, $T\in\Sigma^n$ and threshold $k$, identify occurrences whose Hamming distance from $P$ is at most $k$, using the paper's compact representation of occurrence sets. Complexity counts character queries separately from processing and output.
